insights.content: DTC #3 is 6-0, the only unbeaten team in the division. W6 win over TPC was tighter than expected — Yarisbel won S1 6-2 6-2 and DTC #3 won S2 and D3 cleanly, but TPC took both D1 and D2 via 10-point tiebreaks. Final score 3-2. W7 vs Summerlin (5/2) is still the must-win for first place, but Summerlin's lineup looks more manageable on current ratings than feared.

Summerlin beat DTC #2 3-2 and is now 4-2 in second place. Anthem also won 3-2 over Southern Highlands and sits at 4-2. Red Rock CC beat LTF 3-2 and climbs to 2-4. DTC #2 drops to 2-4. TPC is 3-3, still mathematically alive but fading.

Summerlin's 3.0 roster is weaker on current ratings than the previous analysis indicated. Kim Springer (bl=3.25) has dipped to 3.15 — she has lost ground since her early wins. Tayoni Coleman (bl=2.92) is at 2.87 in the 3.0 division. Tina Nathalia (bl=2.91) is at 2.87. These are competitive players but DTC #3 has the rating edge at every line. The main risk is lineup depth — Summerlin plays 5 lines and has enough bodies to cause problems.

Darian McCauley (bl=2.92, r=3.03, 4-0) and Yarisbel (bl=3.10, r=3.12, 5-0) are DTC #3's two biggest risers. Shi Oskooi (bl=2.74, r=2.88, 4-0 at D1) has risen significantly. Anna Clark (bl=3.12, r=3.10) has held steady. Kelly Twells (Anthem, bl=3.01, r=3.10) is the division's top riser outside DTC #3.

After W7 vs Summerlin, DTC #3 faces DTC #2 (W8, 5/9), Southern Highlands (W9, 5/16), Red Rock (W10, 5/30), and LTF (W11, 6/6). All four are beatable. Win W7 to clinch first place outright. Even a W7 loss leaves DTC #3 in the driver's seat at 6-1 with a far easier remaining schedule than Summerlin or Anthem.

sections.title: 5/2 — next match preview: DTC #3 vs SUMMERLIN ARBORS

insights.content: DTC #3 (6-0) vs Summerlin (4-2). This is the biggest match of the season. Summerlin just beat DTC #2 3-2 and is the only team that can challenge DTC #3 for first. Win this and first place is essentially locked.

Yarisbel (bl=3.10, r=3.12) vs Summerlin's S1 — most likely Kim Springer (bl=3.25, r=3.15) or Tayoni Coleman (bl=2.92, r=2.87). Yarisbel is favored against either option. Springer's rating has been trending down this season.

Shi/Darian (2.88+3.03) vs Summerlin's best doubles pair. Summerlin's top doubles option is likely Nathalia (r=2.87) + Springer (r=3.15) or a combo from their 3.5 club roster. Shi/Darian are 5-0 together and should hold this line.
TPC won D1 and D2 off DTC #3 last week on tiebreaks — don't get complacent on doubles. Summerlin's depth is their strength. Put the strongest available pair at each doubles line and don't experiment.

DTC #3 wins 4-1. Yarisbel is the clear S1 favorite. Shi/Darian hold D1. The middle three lines (S2, D2, D3) are competitive but DTC #3's rising ratings give them the edge at each. Avoid tiebreak situations by winning set 2 cleanly.
vs SUMMERLIN ARBORS (4-2) — the must-win. Summerlin's current-form ratings are below their baseline at most positions. Win to clinch first place.
vs DTC #2 (2-4). DTC #2 beat Summerlin's D1 and D2 in W6 but lost the match 3-2. Manageable opponent. Watch for Tina Shirey (bl=3.09) and Irene Frazier (bl=2.95) — they've won lines this season.
vs SOUTHERN HIGHLANDS (1-5). Already beat them in W2. Southern Highlands won S1 and D1 against Anthem in W6 — they're not a pushover. Don't coast.
vs RED ROCK CC (2-4). Red Rock beat LTF 3-2 in W6 and is showing signs of life. Rhianna Schwartz (bl=2.90, r=3.00) is a riser to watch.

DTC #3 controls their destiny. Win W7 and first place is locked regardless of what anyone else does. The tiebreak losses to TPC in W6 are a signal to tighten doubles execution — don't let W7 vs Summerlin go to five tiebreaks.
